hints.title: What does each node need?
hints.body: Each node needs the heights of both subtrees and whether both subtrees are balanced.

hints.title: Post-order
hints.body: Children must be measured before their parent, so process left and right first.

hints.title: Combine results
hints.body: A node is balanced when both subtrees are balanced and their heights differ by at most one.
